propositions: Natural fold silently destroys orphan event evidence by retiring un-cited pre-snapshot files and citing their uuids without replaying their effects, erasing the ORPHAN_EVENT signal and making damage unrepairable by tooling.

Fold enumeration must exclude fsck-orphan predicates (pre-snapshot timestamp, uuid absent from prior snapshot's source_event_uuids) from both retirement and source_event_uuids citation, preserving the repair window indefinitely.

Shared is_snapshot_orphan predicate extracted to fsck_repair.py prevents fold and fsck orphan definitions from drifting and ensures routing parity (_AUTO_RECOVER vs _HUMAN_TRIAGE) between repair paths.
Pre-snapshot foldable events must be deferred from folding while their governing snapshot is young, preventing silent orphan burial under a pre-snapshot SNAPSHOT file.
